title: GenAI in education: open materials from course implementations
description: Open materials from course implementations using generative AI in teaching and assessment, organised by year. 2026: system instructions, knowledge files with role-specific rubrics, pre- and post-seminar questionnaires, and qualitative codebook for a literature seminar in which student groups discussed self-selected research papers with an AI Tutor or an AI Student custom GPT (accompanies two papers at IEEE TALE 2026). No student data are included.
